explanation: Place one queen per row. Try each column and reject any placement sharing a column or diagonal with an earlier queen. Copy each complete valid column sequence into the output.
timeComplexity: O(n^2 n!) safe search upper bound including O(n) placement checks.
spaceComplexity: O(n) current placement and recursion space, plus output.
